title: Qxa Audio: Market and product orientation
stem:
All organizations and data in this question are fictional.

Qxa Audio: Qxa’s engineers have designed technically advanced speakers. Interviews suggest customers mainly want simple controls and easier repair, but engineers want to add more settings.

parts.label: a

parts.label: b

title: Yxa Travel: Segmentation and targeting
stem:

Yxa Travel: Yxa sells rail holidays. Retired travellers request weekday departures and step-free access; younger workers request short weekend trips and online booking.

title: Cya Bags: interpreting positioning
stem:
All organizations and data in this question are fictional.

Cya Bags studies the market for day bags. The map uses average customer ratings from 1 (low) to 10 (high) for perceived price and quality. A, B and C are existing competing offers; New is the proposed offer. Ratings are perceptions, not measured technical performance or actual prices.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Define the term position map.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Explain the intended positioning of New relative to A and B.

parts.label: c
parts.prompt: Explain one limitation of using this map alone to decide whether to launch New.

steps.text: A visual representation of customers’ perceptions of competing products
plotted against selected attributes such as perceived price and quality.
New is perceived as cheaper than A.
Its similar high perceived quality suggests a value-for-money position relative to A.
New is perceived as higher-quality and higher-priced than B.
It therefore does not compete solely on the lowest price against B.
Perceptions do not directly measure purchase intentions or segment size.
An apparently empty position may reflect low demand rather than an opportunity.
The two attributes omit other benefits such as convenience, durability or service.
Research on target customers and costs is required before treating the position as commercially viable.

verification.method: Syllabus/AO scope check; independent arithmetic and case-reasoning review; analytic/best-fit allocation audit
